races.rationale: Three compounds with 17-24 stints each, highest accurate-lap share of the candidates, and zero neutralisations to confound the degradation fit.
Extreme degradation: kerb damage to sidewalls forced a mandated 18-lap stint limit, so every stint is short and the wear signal is as strong as this period gets.
Monza: the low-degradation end. Two compounds only and long stints, which is the case a model fitted on high-wear circuits is most likely to get wrong.
Safety car and VSC. The only replay session with neutralisations, so it is the only one where the anomaly attribution can be checked against something other than pit laps.
Street circuit, high track temperature, highest accurate-lap share of the five. Track position dominates strategy here in a way it does not at the permanent circuits.
